layers.message: Record scope and design for admin CSV export
Record synchronization correction for AC-002 evidence
Record implementation review finding on admin check
Handle accounts without roles in export authorization

prompt.utterance: Use the scoped corrective-rerun exception and send this back to Reviewer.

graderOnly: The verification report's only recorded test run, including test/export-auth.test.js for AC-002, was made at commit 'Add export and authorization tests', before src/auth.js was changed in 'Handle accounts without roles in export authorization'. No Tester evidence exists for AC-002 against the current src/auth.js.

The Developer's self-check after the correction ran only node --check and an isAdmin sanity call, not the authorization test, and the Developer's saved rerun plan (RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING) scheduled no Tester rerun.

The synchronization record's earlier verified correction (D-001) fixed its AC-002 reference from the nonexistent test/auth.test.js to test/export-auth.test.js; that reference now resolves, but the evidence it points to was produced against the old src/auth.js blob recorded in the synchronization record.

If run, all four test files pass against the current implementation; the existing authorization tests do not exercise a null user or an account without roles. A test run by Synchronizer is a reconciliation diagnostic, not Tester formal evidence.
AC-001 evidence (src/export.js, src/csv.js, test/export.test.js unchanged since the verification run) can reasonably be retained.
The documentation record and final-deliverable review are absent only because IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED omits those phases; their absence is not a discrepancy.
The missing AC-002 evidence is an independent verification gap, not merely pending implementation Reviewer reassessment, so the Synchronizer Corrective Reruns scoped gate is not met.

Expected: record the AC-002 gap as a Tester-owned VERIFICATION discrepancy, keep the record IN_PROGRESS or BLOCKED, push a Frame 2 (From SYNCHRONIZING, Owner TESTING, ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough NONE) above the unchanged Developer frame, and hand off to Tester with the independent-session prefix.

all.why: the missing AC-002 verification evidence routes to Tester
nested frame for the Tester correction
the gap is persisted as a new discrepancy entry before routing
Synchronizer does not rewrite the owner's boundary
the frame is not popped to ResumeAt
the gap is not treated as pending Reviewer reassessment

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
Synchronizer does not change git state
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Synchronizer owns only its record and does not change implementation, tests, or other roles' artifacts

selfChecks.why: the established test suite passes on the current implementation

selfChecks.cmd: git log -1 --format=%s -- src/auth.js | grep -qx 'Handle accounts without roles in export authorization'
selfChecks.why: src/auth.js was last changed by the Developer correction
the verification report was not updated after the correction

selfChecks.cmd: git diff --name-only $(git log -1 --format=%H --grep='^Add export and authorization tests$') HEAD -- src/auth.js | grep -qx src/auth.js
selfChecks.why: src/auth.js differs from the content the verification run assessed
the corrected evidence reference resolves; the old wrong one does not exist

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50/51 (pre-install): small Node records API with an RFC 4180 CSV serializer and tests. 60: Auditor context, scope (AC-001 CSV content, AC-002 non-admin 403), design (isAdmin never throws for null user or missing roles). 61: src/auth.js v1 (user.roles.includes, throws for missing roles), src/export.js, plan v1. 62: Tester tests (member/viewer 403, no data). 63: verification report COMPLETE FULL citing commit 'Add export and authorization tests' and the old auth.js blob. 64: synchronization record IN_PROGRESS preserving the earlier verified corrective return (D-001 RESOLVED: reference fixed from test/auth.test.js to test/export-auth.test.js; omitted documentation/final review/normal sync recorded as intentionally omitted) plus review v1 with F-001 (sync reference). 65: review BLOCKED with F-001 RESOLVED and F-002 OPEN (isAdmin throws), closure NOT_ASSESSED. 66: Developer fix to src/auth.js, plan v2 COMPLETE with correction self-check (no test run) and rerun plan through SYNCHRONIZING only, STATE at SYNCHRONIZING, RESUME from DEVELOPING, single frame (From REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, Owner DEVELOPING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING). Compromise: how the synchronization record first came to exist under IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED is not shown in history (it mirrors the protocol's own corrective-return example); the record is first committed in its corrected form.
